title: Companies Are Panic Paying for This Skill. Here’s How to Get In
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: The guest plugs his own consultancy website (GDOSC consulting) at the end. The host openly promotes AI consulting as 'one of the biggest opportunities'. None of the revenue figures are verified, and they don't quite match: the intro says $80,000 a month, but a run rate of about $800,000 a year works out to roughly $67,000 a month.

stated_problem.quote: anytime I say I'm in AI, the response is like I just got off a conference call with our CEO and they said we need to do something about AI.
stated_problem.speaker: Brandon Gdosce

idea.name: AI consulting and implementation firm
idea.one_liner: Fractional AI-operations consulting for mid-size and large companies (about 40 to 6,000 staff). It sells audits, workshops and change management, and also builds custom AI and automation solutions. Income comes from one-off audits, project fees and monthly fractional retainers.
idea.customer: Mid-size and enterprise companies (400–500 and around 6,000 employees), plus some 40–50 person agencies and startups
idea.offer: An AI readiness audit, workshops and education, a fractional AI executive who sets up an 'AI operator' framework, and custom builds at level 1/2/3 (ChatGPT features, Zapier/n8n-style automations, custom agentic apps)
idea.revenue_model: One-off audits ($10–15k), project fees, and fractional retainers of $20–35k a month

I actually build the solutions as well so I can get people running.
I would say just go see if you can solve a problem for somebody first
But they want a face for that.
I had a little bit of a reputation of of doing this stuff.

acquisition_channels.details: Clients came through his existing reputation and referrals. He says demand found him within about a month.
His first paid retainer came from his network contact Rachel Woods (an AI-operations figure).
He followed up one interested prospect by email using his own CRM. That prospect never closed.
He advises newcomers to solve one problem for free and then raise prices with each deal.

ideas.delivery: Brandon plus one developer and one contractor. Work covers discovery calls, workshops, an AI readiness survey, and fractional executive work setting up an AI-operator framework and solutions-brief platform. Custom builds use Claude Code (Next.js/MongoDB/Tailwind on Heroku), with Zapier, Relevance AI and n8n for the middle level.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR when handling client data and PII (he says fintech and healthcare are harder). IR35 and off-payroll rules for fractional engagements. Clients may be under the EU AI Act. Emailing limited-company decision-makers is fine under PECR if you include an opt-out.

idea.name: AI readiness survey + auto-generated report and chatbot
idea.one_liner: A staff survey sent across a company, automatically turned by AI into a 15-page AI readiness report plus a chatbot over the results, sold to leadership as a paid audit.
idea.customer: Leadership at companies with hundreds of employees or more
idea.offer: Survey, an AI-summarised report with charts within 2–3 hours, a chatbot over the results, and a prioritised list of use cases
idea.revenue_model: One-off audit fee ($10–15k, according to the guest)

15-page report on the state of your AI readiness.
And I also deliver a chatbot experience with that, too.

claims.quote: so within two hours, three hours of that completing, I can give a, you know, very nice

claims.quote: $10 to $15,000 usually depending on you know how deep we want to go onetime fee

claims.quote: even through the the survey process that I do in the beginning that audit we're pulling out 40 use cases just from that

ideas.delivery: He built his own survey and analysis pipeline. AI writes the report and runs the chatbot. He presents it and upsells further work.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR: employee survey responses are personal data, so you need a lawful basis, a privacy notice and a data processing agreement with the client.

uk_legal_risk.reason: No acquisition channel is stated. In the UK, many HVAC firms are sole traders, so cold SMS, WhatsApp or DM outreach to them would be banned under PECR.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR, including telling callers they are speaking to an AI and that calls are recorded. PECR for any outbound messages the voice agent sends.

ideas.other_uk_rules: DMCC Act 2024 bans fake and incentivised reviews (this matters for an iPhone promotion linked to reviews). CAP Code rules on prize promotions. UK GDPR.

idea.name: Financial advising practice
idea.one_liner: A personal financial advice practice he built by cold calling prospects every day.

key_quotes.quote: I've cold, you know, I built my first financial advising practice by cold calling every day.

uk_legal_risk.reason: The practice relied on cold calling consumers. In the UK, calls must be screened against TPS, unsolicited real-time financial promotions are heavily restricted by FCA COBS 4.8, and pension cold calling is banned outright (2019).

ideas.other_uk_rules: FCA authorisation is required to give financial advice, and the FCA Consumer Duty applies. UK GDPR.
